verdict.rationale: Recurly documents an official public MCP server, Recurly Compass MCP, that lets AI agents such as Claude Desktop or Cursor connect and work with Recurly's tools and APIs, and a probe confirms the official MCP server page exists. Missing for 10: detailed setup and authentication steps, clarity on whether the server performs live account operations beyond documentation and API knowledge, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Recurly Compass MCP is a public MCP server that lets AI agents — such as Claude Desktop or Cursor — work directly with Recurly's tools and APIs, without complex setup.
Recurly Compass MCP connects your AI development tools directly to Recurly's documentation and API knowledge.
